reasonManagementRequired.en: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
reasonManagementRequired.zh: 插件管理所需，不能停用或卸载

reasonUnaddressable.en: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
reasonUnaddressable.zh: 当前 profile 的 patch 无法唯一定位这一项

reasonInvalidSpec.en: Enter a valid package name or address.
reasonInvalidSpec.zh: 请输入有效的包名或地址

reasonAmbiguousInstall.en: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
reasonAmbiguousInstall.zh: 无法从依赖变更中确定安装了哪一个包

reasonNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
reasonNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理

reasonNotRemovable.en: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
reasonNotRemovable.zh: 这个包不属于当前 profile，或者是插件管理所需的组件

reasonStopProfile.en: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
reasonStopProfile.zh: 这个 profile 没有启用 HMR，正在使用的包要停止后用 dsh plugin 卸载

reasonBundleInUse.en: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
reasonBundleInUse.zh: 其他配置仍在使用这个组合包的组件，请先停用它们

reasonStaleApproval.en: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
reasonStaleApproval.zh: 待允许的安装脚本列表已变化，请重新安装以刷新
